title: Human Resources Management in the Hospitality Industry

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, role, importance, and functions of human resource management within the context of the hospitality industry.
Analyze job roles and responsibilities within the hospitality sector.
Implement effective recruitment strategies for the hospitality industry.
Evaluate employee performance using appropriate metrics and methods.
Design and implement training programs to enhance workforce capabilities.
Manage compensation packages to motivate employees effectively.
Apply problem-solving techniques to address human resource challenges.
Develop and deliver presentations on human resource topics.
